description: T-5358 (the column axis; table-delete-all-columns answers it for a table with a header row): one delete_column of B:C (count 2), every column of a table without a header row. Sales on S!B3:C6 without a header row (columns Column1/Column2, data rows 3-6: E,W,N,S and Qty 1,2,4,8), S!A4 'left' and S!H4 'right'. Sheet F holds A1 =SUM(Sales[Column2]), A2 FORMULATEXT(A1), A3 =COLUMNS(Sales), A4 =ROWS(Sales), A5 =ROWS(Sales[#All]), A6 =SUM(S!C3:C6), A7 FORMULATEXT(A6), A8 =ISREF(Sales), A9 =S!H4, A10 FORMULATEXT(A9) (how far the cells right of the table move).
